locationUrls.title: TripAdvisor location URLs
locationUrls.description: One or more TripAdvisor hotel, attraction, or restaurant review URLs. Example: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g60763-d93589-Reviews-The_Pierre_A_Taj_Hotel-New_York.html

locationUrl.title: Single location URL (alternative)
locationUrl.description: Single TripAdvisor URL. Used only if locationUrls is empty.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per location
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per location. Prevents runaway charges on properties with thousands of reviews.

filterByRating.title: Filter by rating
filterByRating.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Leave empty for all ratings.

language.title: Language filter
language.description: Only return reviews in this language. Leave empty for all languages. Example: en, es, fr, de, it

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxies recommended for TripAdvisor.
